comments.en:
This driver is developed for HBPLv1 printers (with extended code set) like the Xerox Phaser 6000B and the Xerox Phaser 6010N printers.

If you have another printer that works using these codes, please notify the developers or maintainers for this project.

Images to print Resolution is limited to 600x600 dpi, and you should stay at least 50 pixels (2mm) away from the edges to avoid clipping.
